rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, wells placed on sites by tap and with the panel, wells dragged to other sites and off the dish with the swim preview, the swim played, the shown tick scrubbed, the field frozen, actions undone and redone, the camera orbited, levels retried and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner taps sites, drags wells and the scrubber, taps the field, double-taps empty space and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on a free site sends exactly one well.place; a drag of a well (16 points or more) shows the previewed swim and sends exactly one well.place to the new site or one well.remove off the dish on release; a drag along the scrubber shows the nearest tick under the finger; a tap on the field toggles the freeze; a gesture on a finished play explains why nothing happens; a double tap on empty space (within 0.35 s and 22 points) restores the authored view.
rows.procedure: Tap a site to place the chosen well, drag a well to another site and off the dish to preview the swim and move or remove it, drag along the scrubber to show a tick, tap the field to freeze, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency
